Hi Avery / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick sync on the co-sell. Stratus will run the joint walkthrough and CloudAnchor will demo the marketplace listing and procurement flow. We have a short runway and two constraints from the SI side: 1) our lead engineer Rohit is only available in the afternoon PST window this week, and 2) CloudAnchor prefers a split host model so they can demo the listing immediately after our integration segment.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Thu 3/30, 11:30–12:30 PT (tight, 60m)
- Option B: Thu 3/30, 15:30–16:30 PT (ideal for Rohit)
- Option C: Fri 3/31, 09:00–10:00 PT (backup)

Do any of these work? We also want a 30-minute rehearsal 30 minutes before the live demo (tech check + run-of-show).

Attached: initial demo deck + short runbook (v1).

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Partnerships, Stratus Systems

- Avery: We can host the 15:30–16:30 PT slot (Option B) but Marissa on Marketplace needs to confirm she can join at 16:00 PT for the marketplace handoff — does CloudAnchor need the full hour for their segment or just 15–20 minutes at the end?
- Rehearsal: Agree on a 30-minute tech check. Can we do 15:00–15:30 PT on Thu 3/30 for the rehearsal?
- Tech SME: Please include Rohit (from Stratus) and add our on-call demo engineer: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — he'll manage the Dedicated capacity settings during the demo.
- Runbook: I made a few ops edits and am attaching runbook_v3.pdf (finalized checklist + rollback notes). Please review the sequenced host handoff at 16:00 PT (page 4).

If we lock Option B I will send calendar invites and a short prep note to attendees. Also: can CloudAnchor confirm whether they want screen-sharing to remain with them for the marketplace transaction (recommended) or for Redwood to take over for the final procurement flow?

Avery Johnson

Looping in a quick scheduling note: the 15:30–16:30 PT slot is blocked by a pre-existing renewal call for one of our mid-market customers that I need to cover. I can cover the demo at 16:00 PT onward (as Avery noted) but we should avoid losing continuity between the Stratus integration segment and the CloudAnchor transaction demo. Two suggestions: 

1) Staggered handover — Stratus runs 15:30–16:00 and CloudAnchor runs 16:00–16:30. Redwood joins both segments for introductions and the final Q&A. This matches the split-host model Samir mentioned.

2) If we need a contiguous hour for continuity, shift the demo to 16:00–17:00 PT (would that still work for Rohit?). If not, option 2 is to run the core integration at 15:30–15:55 and hold a 10-minute intermission for a fast handoff, then CloudAnchor resumes.

Also — Ben Carter will need the Dedicated pool configured with 4 T4-equivalent GPUs for the integration walkthrough (quantized model serving + live prompt microbenchmarks). Samir, can Stratus confirm they are comfortable with a 10–15s latency expectation for 1k token demo samples?

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
